title: YouTube Recipes — Playlist Digests
description: YouTube Recipes playlist cards — searchable ingredients and tools.

recipes.title: Vegetable Teriyaki Noodles
recipes.meta: My Ginger Garlic Kitchen · ~20 min · serves 4
remember: Cook noodles first. Oil them so they don’t glue.
Veg stays crunchy. Don’t stew them.
Sauce last. 50g bottled teriyaki is the whole sauce.
do: Boil noodles. Drain. Rinse cold. Toss with 2 tsp oil.
Hot pan, 2 tbsp oil, garlic 1 min.
Add sliced onion, carrot, peppers, mushrooms, broccoli + pepper + chili flake. Stir until just tender.
50g teriyaki. Coat. Add noodles. Toss. Salt + optional hot sauce.
Sesame. Peanuts only if you want them.
watch: Soft veg = cafeteria noodles.
Salt before tasting the teriyaki and you’ll oversalt.
Peanuts are garnish, not required.
recipes.reaction: Fine weeknight bowl. Nobody talks about it the next day.

recipes.title: One-Pan Mongolian Beef Noodles
recipes.meta: RecipeTin Eats · 15 min · serves 4
remember: Instant noodle cakes, uncooked. Throw the seasoning packet.
Sauce first, water second, noodles last.
Broccoli small or it stays raw.
do: Mix sauce: 2 tbsp dark soy, 3 tbsp hoisin, 2 tbsp mirin (or Shaoxing + 2 tsp sugar), ¼ tsp five-spice, 2 tsp sesame oil.
Hot deep pan, 2 tbsp oil. Onion + 2 garlic, 30 sec.
500g beef mince. Brown. Pour in sauce. Coat.
5 cups small broccoli. Stir.
2¼ cups water. Simmer. Break 4 noodle cakes in half. Push in.
30 sec, flip, 30 sec, then untangle. 2–3 min until sauce is gone.
watch: Boiling the noodles separately ruins the point.
Big broccoli florets stay hard.
Light soy works but the color goes pale.
recipes.reaction: People eat the whole pan. Then they look for the recipe.

recipes.title: Brown Butter Banana Bread Cookie Bars
recipes.meta: Well Made by Kiley · 8×8 pan
extras: Full grams live on her site (recipe card is JS-gated). Method below is the part that matters.
remember: Brown the butter until amber and nutty. Cool 15–20 min.
Exactly ½ cup (120g) mashed ripe banana. Not “a banana.”
8×8 pan. 9×9 makes thin sad bars.
do: Brown salted butter. Cool.
Beat in brown sugar + white sugar.
Banana + egg + vanilla.
Flour + cornstarch + leavening + salt + cinnamon. Don’t overmix.
Fold chocolate chips / wafers. 8×8 pan.
Bake until edges set and center is just soft. Cool before cutting.
watch: Hot brown butter scrambles the mix.
Extra banana = cakey, not bar.
Cutting hot = collapse.
recipes.reaction: People say “why is this better than banana bread.” Because it’s a cookie.

recipes.title: Crispy Salt & Pepper Chicken Thighs
recipes.meta: Xiao Li’s Kitchen · ~50 min with marinade · 500g
remember: Beer soak 10 min. Don’t rinse after.
Cornstarch + oil seal before the pan.
Skin down. Don’t touch for 3–4 min.
do: Boneless skin-on thighs. Tap with knife back.
Cover with 330ml beer. 10 min. Drip off. No rinse.
Marinate 30 min: ginger, scallion whites, ½ onion, 1 tbsp light soy, 1 tbsp oyster, 1 tsp 椒盐 / salt-and-pepper mix.
Dump the aromatics. Toss chicken with 1 tbsp cornstarch + 1 tbsp oil.
Medium-low pan, 2 tbsp oil. Skin down. 3–4 min still. Flip. Cook through.
No 椒盐? 1 tsp salt + ½ tsp pepper + pinch five-spice.
watch: Moving the skin early tears it.
High heat burns the coat before the meat is done.
Rinsing after beer washes off the tenderizing.
recipes.reaction: People argue about the beer. Then they make it again.

recipes.title: One-Pan Chicken Alfredo
recipes.meta: Steel Pan Guy · ~20 min
remember: Chicken is for the brown bits. Sauce lives on those bits.
Cream on the fond. Cold butter + cheese off heat.
Pinch of nutmeg in every white sauce.
do: Preheat stainless. Water droplet should dance. Tiny bit of high-smoke oil on the chicken, not a slick in the pan.
Salt-and-pepper chicken breast. Sear ~2 min a side. Don’t rip it off early. Rest it out.
Pour cream (half-and-half or heavy) onto the fond. Scrape. Pinch nutmeg.
Cook fettuccine. Save a splash of pasta water.
Off heat: cold butter (~4 tbsp) then handfuls of Parmigiano (Romano if you have it). Toss pasta + sliced chicken. Loosen with pasta water if tight.
watch: Cheese on a raging burner = grainy sauce.
No fond = bland cream.
This is not authentic Alfredo. People in the comments will tell you.
recipes.reaction: 7.9 million views. Half the comments are “that’s not Alfredo.” The other half made it for dinner.

recipes.title: Fried Apple Hand Pies
recipes.meta: Well Made by Kiley · ~2 hr 20 min · 11–13 pies
remember: Cool the filling all the way. Warm filling leaks.
Cold dough. Fork the seam, then fold the edge in.
Oil 360–370°F. Use a thermometer.
do: Filling: 58g butter, 4 diced apples, 110g brown sugar, 60g maple, cinnamon, pinch salt. ~10 min. Slurry 11g cornstarch + 1½ tbsp water, 1–2 min. Vanilla off heat. Cool.
Dough: 420g flour, 12g sugar, 8g baking powder (blog writes “2”), 6g salt. Cut in 170g cold butter. 7 oz cold half-and-half + 1 cold egg. Disc. Chill 30 min.
Roll. Cut ~4½" rounds. Heaping tablespoon filling. Egg-wash the edge. Fold, fork, fold the edge in. Chill.
~2" oil. Fry ~2 min a side. Glaze warm: 120g powdered sugar, 58g browned butter, 80g maple, 1 tbsp milk, vanilla, pinch salt.
Oven instead: 400°F, 22–25 min, egg wash, a vent slit.
watch: More than a heaping tablespoon will not seal.
Kneading makes a tough crust.
Once frying, hold about 350–365°F. Low = greasy. High = brown outside, raw inside.
recipes.reaction: 79k views. People call them a favorite. Fried, not baked, is the reason.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Vietnamese Lemongrass Chicken Noodle Bowl
recipes.meta: Karen Law · under 30 min · serves 2
remember: Skin-on thighs. Breast dries in the air fryer.
Rinse the noodles cold so they stay bouncy.
Taste the nuoc cham before it hits the bowl.
do: Marinade on 4 deboned skin-on thighs: 1 minced lemongrass, 3 tbsp fish sauce, 2 tbsp sugar, 1 tbsp light soy, 1 tbsp garlic, ½ tbsp cornstarch, juice of ½ lime.
Nuoc cham: 4 tbsp fish sauce, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp garlic, 1 bird’s eye chili, juice of 1 lime, ⅓ cup warm water.
Rice vermicelli per the package, then rinse cold. Amount not listed. One nest a person.
Air fry skin down, 185°C (365°F), 13–15 min. Flip halfway.
Slice over noodles with julienned cucumber and carrot, gem lettuce, coriander. Drizzle sauce.
watch: Breast, same time, goes dry.
Skip the rinse and the noodles glue.
Don’t store it mixed. Chicken, noodles, and veg apart, up to 3 days. Fresh sauce when you eat.
recipes.reaction: 47k views. Quiet comments. A weeknight bowl people finish.

remember: No biscuit base. High heat. The top should go dark.
Centre is still jiggly when it comes out.
It sinks in the middle. Rest it before you cut.
do: Room-temp ingredients so it blends smooth.
Parchment up the sides so it can rise and look rough.
Fresh vanilla beans if you have them. Amount not in the free text.
Bake hot until the top is charred, not tan. Temp and time: unknown.
Cool until it settles, then slice.
watch: Pale top plus a long bake kills the gooey middle.
Cutting hot and it slumps.
No parchment and it sticks and can’t rise.
recipes.reaction: About 2 million views on the Short. People want the dark top. The grams live on the paid post.

recipes.title: Smoked Chuck Roast
recipes.meta: jackieh · smoke 3 hr + crockpot 3–4 hr · 2–3 lb
extras: Recipe is the video description. No blog.
remember: Smoke at 225°F for 3 hours. Flip once.
Then broth halfway up the meat. Crockpot on high, 3–4 hours. Flip once.
Store it in some of the liquid or it dries.
do: Coat a 2–3 lb boneless chuck with oil and a steak rub. He uses Black & Tan by Fire & Smoke.
Smoke 225°F, 3 hours, flip halfway.
Crockpot on high. Add 1–2 cups bone broth or beef stock, about halfway up.
3–4 hours, flip halfway.
Cut big chunks, then split with a fork. Don’t shred the whole roast into strings.
watch: A full shred goes stringy.
A dry container tomorrow means you left the liquid behind.
Too little broth and it never half-covers.
recipes.reaction: 2.8 million views. The method is the whole recipe. People make it because the steps are short.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Chicken Noodle Soup (Phở Gà)
recipes.meta: Julia Vuong · 20 min pressure + 10 min release · serves 4
extras: YouTube description empty. Card from her Instant Pot post: https://instantpot.com/blogs/recipes/vietnamese-chicken-noodle-soup
remember: Bone-in chicken. That’s the broth.
Char the onion and ginger. Toast the spices.
Go light on fish sauce. It darkens the soup. More bouillon if you want savor.
do: Char 1 large onion, quartered, and sliced ginger. Toast 5 star anise, 5 cloves, 2 bay leaves, 1 cinnamon stick, 5 peppercorns.
Instant Pot: those, a whole chicken, 8 cups water, 1½ tbsp chicken bouillon, 1½ tbsp rock sugar. High pressure 20 min. Natural release 10. Skim.
2 tbsp fish sauce, tasted, not dumped.
Sauce: 3 tbsp neutral oil, minced ginger and 2 tbsp scallion, 30 seconds. ½ tsp garlic salt. 1 tsp sesame oil.
24 oz rice noodles, cooked to the package. Bowl with broth, chicken, sliced onion, cilantro, lime, and the sauce.
watch: Too much fish sauce turns the broth dark.
Skip the char and the toast and it tastes like plain chicken water.
Leave the scum and the bowl looks gray.
recipes.reaction: 399k views. Fast phở, not a six-hour pot. The bones still did the work.

recipes.title: Egg Drop Soup
recipes.meta: Jujumao · stock 1–2 hr · serves unknown
remember: Blanch the chicken and the feet. Throw that water out.
Gentle simmer, then strain.
Flick the eggs forward. Do not dump them.
do: Blanch 1 kg chicken feet and 1 whole chicken with a thumb of sliced ginger and 2 tbsp Shaoxing, 5–10 min. Discard the liquid. Rinse the scum.
Soak 3/4 cup dried mushrooms, and 1/2 cup dried scallops if you want them, 15–30 min.
Clean pot: chicken, 3 smashed ginger pieces, 1 cup chopped green onion, 1 medium radish, the mushroom liquid, 1–2 tbsp Shaoxing, water to cover. Simmer 1–2 hr. Strain.
Season: fish sauce, 2 tsp white pepper, 1 tsp sugar, 2 tbsp sesame oil, 1/4 cup light soy, salt. Thicken with potato starch. Start at 1/2 cup starch in a little water.
Stream in 6 beaten eggs, flicking. Sliced scallions.
watch: Skip the blanch and the stock stays cloudy.
Too much slurry and it turns glue.
Eggs dumped in become clumps, not ribbons.
recipes.reaction: 6.9 million views. People put it on when they feel sick. The stock is the point.

Dough: 420g flour, 12g sugar, 1 tsp baking powder, 6g salt, 170g cold salted butter, 7 oz cold half-and-half, 1 cold egg. Chill 30 min.
Cut 4½" rounds. Heaping tablespoon. Egg-wash the edge. Fork. Fold the edge in.

recipes.title: Italian Stromboli
recipes.meta: Carman Wilken · ~30 min · serves 8
remember: Leave a border. Pinch every seam. Seam side down.
Cut slits so steam can leave.
Rest 5 min or the cheese runs out.
do: One refrigerated crust, about 13 oz. Spread 1/4 cup pizza sauce, not the whole jar.
Layer 1/4 lb ham, 1/4 lb salami, 1/4 lb pepperoni, 3 cups grated mozzarella, 1 tsp Italian seasoning.
Roll, pinch, seam down. Slits on top.
Brush 2 tbsp melted butter, garlic powder, dried parsley. The last two have no amount.
400°F, about 20 min. Rest 5. Rest of the sauce for dipping.
watch: Open seams and the filling escapes.
Cut it hot and it is a puddle.
Stretch the dough thin and it tears.
recipes.reaction: 3.7 million views. The deli counter did the hard part.

recipes.title: Cheesy Baked Ziti
recipes.meta: Allrecipes · Nicole’s Best Baked Ziti · 1 hr 25 min + 10 min rest · serves 8
remember: Boil the pasta 1–2 min short of the package.
Ricotta is its own layer. Do not stir it through.
Stand 10 min before you scoop.
do: Oven 375°F. Grease a 9×13. Boil 16 oz ziti with 1 tbsp kosher salt, about 8 min.
Brown ¾ lb Italian sausage and ¾ lb ground sirloin. Add 1 small onion, 2 garlic cloves, salt, pepper, ¼ tsp chili flake, 3–5 min.
Two 24 oz jars marinara, plus ¼ cup water shaken in each jar. Simmer 10 min. Toss the pasta with a little sauce.
Ricotta mix: 15 oz whole-milk ricotta, ½ cup Parmesan, 1 egg, 1 tbsp parsley, 1 tbsp basil, remaining salt and pepper.
Layer sauce, pasta, sauce, ricotta, mozzarella, the rest of the pasta and sauce and cheese, last ¼ cup Parmesan. Bake 25–30 min. Rest 10.
watch: Pasta cooked all the way on the stove goes mushy in the oven.
Skip the jar rinse and the sauce comes up short.
Serve it straight from the oven and the layers fall apart.
recipes.reaction: 292k views. A tray people already know. The layering is why this version.

recipes.title: Burnt Basque Cheesecake

Updated weights only.

400g cream cheese and 120g sugar, smooth. 3 eggs, one at a time. ½ tsp vanilla and 200ml heavy cream. Sift in 20g cornstarch.
Pour. Tap out bubbles. Bake 30 min at 220–240°C, lower rack.
Rest in the tin at least 2 hours. Fridge overnight if you want it firmer.
watch: The video’s old quantities do not match the post.
Unmold it hot and it slumps.

Freeze in a Creami pint. Button and time: unknown.

Stirring the apple mix into the base. It is separate.
Guessing a respin. Not in the text.

recipes.title: Mongolian Chicken
recipes.meta: iamneverfull · 30 min · serves 2
remember: Sear the chicken so the sauce has something to grab.
Dashi is the restaurant taste. Bouillon works if you have no dashi.

do: 16 oz boneless skinless thighs, bite size. 1 tbsp Shaoxing, ½ tsp salt, 1 tbsp cornstarch. 15 min.
Sauce: 1 tbsp dark soy, 1 tbsp light soy, 1 tsp dashi, 3 tbsp water, 1½ tbsp sugar.
Medium-high oil. Sear chicken about 5 min. Out.
Same pan: 1 onion in chunks and scallion whites, 2–3 min, a little char.
Chicken back in with the sauce until it coats. Scallion greens at the end. Rice if you want it.
watch: No dashi and it tastes flatter. Use bouillon or skip it, but know the difference.
A crowded pan will not brown.
Peanuts or cashews are a tip, not the dish. Skip the peanuts.

recipes.title: Beef Pot Roast with Gravy
recipes.meta: Sara · Nutrient Matters · about 3 hr 40 min · servings unknown
remember: Sear it. The gravy lives on that fond.
325°F, covered, about 3 hours.
Strain the liquid and press the onion and garlic before you make gravy.
do: Oven 325°F. 2 lb bottom blade roast. Montreal seasoning, salt, pepper.
Dutch oven, 2 tbsp beef tallow. Sear 5–7 min a side. Out.
Spanish onion 4–6 min. 4–6 garlic cloves 30–60 sec. 1 tbsp tomato paste 2–3 min.
Whisk 1 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp soy, 1 tbsp ketchup, 1 tbsp apple cider vinegar. Deglaze.
Beef back in. 2 cups beef broth, 2 cups chicken broth, rosemary, thyme, 2 bay leaves. Cover. About 3 hours. Carrots in for the last 45–60 min.
Strain. Roux: 4 tbsp butter and 4 tbsp flour, 2–3 min, then 4 cups of that liquid. ½ tsp white pepper and a little browning sauce. Half the liquid means half the roux.
watch: Burn the fond and the gravy is bitter.
Wrong roux ratio and it is paste or water.
Carrots in at the start go soft. Later they keep a bite.

Meat back in, 2 bay leaves. Cover, low, 1½ hours.

remember: Campanelle, so the meat sits in the curls.
Lid on for about 15 min. That cooks the pasta.
Cheese after the pasta, then lid again.
do: 1.5 lb ground beef or turkey with ¼ cup green pepper and ¼ cup onion. Brown.
Garlic powder, onion powder, all-purpose seasoning, to taste. 1 tbsp tomato paste. 1 cup tomato sauce.
2 cups chicken or beef broth. Optional pinch of bouillon. 1 cup heavy cream. 3 cups Campanelle.
Cover about 15 min.
1–2 cups shredded cheese. Cover until it melts.
watch: A big bowl looks like less food than it is. The title says family of 4 for about $10.

recipes.title: Shepherd’s Pie
recipes.meta: Sara · Nutrient Matters · 55 min · 11×8 dish
remember: Cook the flour in the beef fat. That is the thickener.
Egg yolks in the mash so it bakes creamy and still holds.
Fork ridges and extra Pecorino. That is the crust.
do: Brown 2 lb minced beef with salt and pepper. Yellow onion and 1½ cups shredded carrot, 2–3 min. 3–4 garlic cloves, 60 sec.
2 tbsp tomato paste. 3 tbsp flour, 2–3 min. Add 1–2 tbsp oil if the beef was lean.

1½ tbsp soy, 1 heaping tbsp ketchup, 1½ tbsp white vinegar. 2½ cups broth (or water plus bouillon: 1 beef cube and ½ chicken). Rosemary, ½ tsp thyme, ½ tsp allspice. Cover, simmer about 10 min. 1 cup frozen peas for the last 5.

Oven 400°F. Boil 2½–3 lb yellow potatoes 10–15 min. Dry them in the pot. Mash with 1 stick butter, ½ cup warm heavy cream, ¾ cup Pecorino, 2 tsp parsley, ½ tsp garlic powder, 2 egg yolks. One line on the blog says milk. Use the cream.
Beef in an 11×8 dish. Mash on top. Fork plus a little olive oil. Pepper and more Pecorino.
20–25 min. Broil 2–3 min. Rest 5.
watch: Spreading the mash hard stirs up the meat. Pipe it if you can.
Lean beef and the flour burns. Add the oil.
Watery mince needs longer than 10 min. The blog’s readers hit this.
recipes.reaction: 3.8 million views. Winter pie. People come back for the crust, not the mince.

recipes.title: Bourbon Chicken
